observation: Producer/evaluator split caught two genuine CRITICALs invisible to the architect (R1 6/10). (1) Factory-bootstrap split assumed a server-boot step, but applyFactoryBootstrap(db) runs on 4 registry-less paths (desktop standalone pglite + 3 leaf CLIs setup-cli/bootstrap-pg/seed-pg-cli) that never touch the Strategy registry — the split would silently drop facilitator creation and break the AF17 golden. Resolved by registry-free FactoryRosterSpec value injection in @hyperidle/shared. (2) ESLint guard banned importing BUILTIN_ASSISTANT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, a module-local const never imported — vacuous, zero enforcement. Resolved by no-restricted-syntax catching a reintroduced inline persona const. Pattern: critique catches architectural/boundary constraints a passing test suite cannot.

Green-phase builder ran ship-phase actions during Phase 3 implementation: npm run verify, attestation commits (42fa8138, 9f26909d), AND flipped the draft PR to ready. Orchestrator had to revert PR to draft + restore a deleted attestation file before review. Signal: green-phase builder prompt must explicitly forbid verify-as-gate, attestation commits, and PR-state changes — those belong to /ship (Phase 5).

Code review R1 caught CRITICAL the green suite missed: POST /api/users changed to wrapped {user} shape on the 201 path only; 200 idempotent path stayed flat. SetupFlow.tsx read userBody?.id -> undefined on first registration -> POST /api/teams got userId:undefined -> assistant welcome-message seeding silently skipped. Integration tests asserted the route response shape per spec but never exercised the cross-call handoff (frontend reads response -> passes userId to next route). Fix: both branches return {user}; new AK6-user-team-handoff.integration.test exercises the real handoff end-to-end. Signal: contract-shape changes need a handoff/integration test, not just an isolated shape assertion.

Tools create_team + add_agent routed through the port + persisted but emitted no creation events; only HTTP routes emitted. AC2 requires every creation surface to emit the trigger. Caught in code-review WARNING, not tests. Signal: when a tool and a route both create the same entity, require side-by-side tests asserting the event fires on BOTH paths.

L full-stack ownership-seam WP. ~6h wall concept->docs. /design + /design-critique correctly skipped (no UI). Architecture critique 2 rounds (6->8, two genuine CRITICAL redesigns). Green phase ~2.5h single-tail with task-boundary commits. Code review 2 rounds (NOT DONE -> DONE: 1 CRITICAL handoff regression + 1 WARNING event-emission gap). High-value phases (critique, review) each caught non-overlapping real defects that would otherwise have shipped.
